metadata.name: Gemini Translate
metadata.author: kanaru313
metadata.description: Translates lyrics line by line with the Google Gemini API, keeping the singer’s voice and the lines in sync. Needs your own API key from aistudio.google.com/app/apikey; the lines, and the title, artist and lyrics when song context is on, are sent to Google.

apiKeys.title: Gemini API keys
apiKeys.subtitle: One or more keys, separated by commas or new lines; the next key is used when one is refused or out of quota

options.title: Natural: the meaning, as a native speaker says it
Close to the original: for learning the language
Singable: fits the melody, rhymes where it can

thinking.title: Thinking
thinking.subtitle: Low answers faster and fits the time limit; Auto lets the model think as long as it likes

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.subtitle: 0.0 to 2.0; low values keep the translation stable

safetyFilter.title: Gemini safety filter
safetyFilter.subtitle: Off by default: sends BLOCK_NONE for harassment, hate speech, sexually explicit and dangerous content, which love and breakup songs often trip

retryUntranslated.title: Retry skipped lines
retryUntranslated.subtitle: Calls Gemini once more for lines it left out or left in the source language

useSongContext.title: Send the song as context
useSongContext.subtitle: Sends the title, artist and full lyrics with each chunk so pronouns and terms stay consistent; costs more tokens

customInstruction.title: Your own instruction
customInstruction.subtitle: Added to every request, for example: keep English lines in English

systemPrompt.title: System prompt
systemPrompt.subtitle: The whole instruction; keep {target_language}, {target_notes}, {style_prompt}, {song_prompt} and {custom_instruction} where you want them filled. Empty uses the built-in prompt
